Oktober 2026 eine engagierte Persönlichkeit als Wissenschaftlicher Mitarbeiter (m/w/d) für das Projekt MAPS Vollzeit (100 %) / Entgeltgruppe 13 TV-L / befristet bis September 2029 Das Projekt „Jugend am Scheideweg: Marginalisierung und Mainstream in der politischen Sozialisation von geﬂüchteten Jugendlichen in Deutschland“ (MAPS) untersucht die politische Sozialisation junger muslimischer Geflüchteter in Deutschland und fragt, wie Erfahrungen von Zugehörigkeit und gesellschaftlicher Teilhabe sowie von Ausgrenzung und Diskriminierung politische Einstellungen und gesellschaftliches Engagement prägen. Support project teams in assessing and improving contractor performance, including productivity, workmanship quality, and compliance with contractual and technical requirements. Support tender teams in optimizing bids to gain competitiveness in the market Act as a troubleshooter on site, helping to analyze execution challenges and implement practical corrective measures in collaboration with project teams. Serve as a trusted sparring partner for project managers and site leadership, strengthening execution maturity without replacing line responsibility. What You Bring Several years of hands‑on experience in site execution and site management for energy, infrastructure, or EPC/turnkey projects (substations, grid solutions, or comparable environments preferred). Strong practical understanding of civil works and electrical installation activities on complex construction sites. Strong knowledge of the offer management process and ability to transfer execution knowledge to support tender teams in cost and time estimations and supplier selections Solid knowledge of EHS and Quality Management principles in site execution environments, with the ability to translate standards into daily practice. Proven ability to advise, coach, and influence site teams and contractors without direct line authority. Pragmatic, solution‑oriented mindset with the credibility to be accepted on site by supervisors, contractors, and project managers. Ability to identify risks early, communicate clearly, and escalate constructively where necessary.
